definitions.explanation: A white surface or background, especially on fabric, paper, or ceramics, onto which patterns or text may be applied.
An empty, unfilled area on a document, form, or surface where nothing has been written or printed.

examples.japanese: {白地|しろじ}に{青|あお}い{花柄|はながら}のワンピース。
examples.english: A dress with a blue floral pattern on a white background.

examples.japanese: {白地|しろじ}に{赤|あか}い{水玉|みずたま}のシャツを{着|き}ている。
examples.english: She is wearing a white shirt with red polka dots.

examples.japanese: {白地|しろじ}の{茶碗|ちゃわん}に{藍色|あいいろ}の{模様|もよう}が{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The indigo pattern on the white tea bowl is beautiful.

examples.japanese: {白地|しろじ}の{部分|ぶぶん}にサインしてください。
examples.english: Please sign in the blank area.

examples.japanese: {地図|ちず}の{白地|しろじ}は{未調査|みちょうさ}の{地域|ちいき}を{示|しめ}す。
examples.english: The blank areas on the map indicate unsurveyed regions.

examples.japanese: {白地|しろじ}{地図|ちず}に{国名|こくめい}を{書|か}き{込|こ}む{授業|じゅぎょう}をした。
examples.english: We had a class where we filled in country names on a blank map.

notes:
A compound of {白|しろ} (white) and {地|じ} (ground, base, fabric). The {地|じ} here refers to the base surface or background, the same character used in {生地|きじ} (fabric, material).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白地|しろじ}に～ — a pattern/design on a white background
- {白地|しろじ}{地図|ちず} — blank map (outline map without labels)
- {白地|しろじ}の{皿|さら} — plain white plate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無地|むじ} — solid color, plain (no pattern at all, not necessarily white)
- {余白|よはく} — margin, blank space (on paper or in a document)
- {黒地|くろじ} — black background (same pattern with different color)
